info.title: Moovha provider wallet operations
info.description: Source contract for the initial EOA profile; not deployed. No v1 handlers are enabled by this artifact. Financial operations require tenant/owner/current stored ID VERIFIED, current grant, certified capabilities and sponsorship before side effects. Mutations require idempotency scoped to environment/client/subject/method/resource; JCS request hash conflicts return 409. HTTP replay retention is at least 24 hours; financial identities outlive that cache. Reject duplicate JSON keys, unknown request fields and bodies over 262144 bytes. OAuth errors retain standard OAuth semantics. Native and worker authentication are separate policies and are not represented as provider bearer alternatives. Optional advanced account drivers remain unavailable.

ProviderAccess.description: Verified provider OAuth access token with trusted issuer/audience/environment/client and per-operation scopes. ID tokens are not accepted. Authorization-server metadata/URLs will be published from the tested oidc-provider configuration; this draft does not invent token endpoints. Client credentials alone do not authorize owner account access.

IdempotencyKey.name: Idempotency-Key
IdempotencyKey.description: Random UUID; same canonical request returns original resource; changed body is 409. Not a financial dispatch retry token.

Cursor.name: cursor
Cursor.description: Opaque, tenant-bound cursor; never an arbitrary SQL offset.

Problem.description: Safe RFC 9457 error; 401 unauthenticated, 403 unauthorized, 404 invisible/missing, 409 revision/idempotency conflict, 422 invalid or unsupported, 429 rate/budget limit, 503 dependency unavailable.

Retry-After.description: Seconds before a read/admission retry; never authorizes repeating a spend.

Uint256.description: Canonical unsigned base-unit decimal string, at most 2^256-1. Never parse through Number.

ChainAccountId.description: CAIP-10 EVM account. Chain agreement and checksum/canonical identity are semantic checks.

AssetId.description: Pinned CAIP-19 fungible profile. Registry distinguishes native, underlying and share assets; symbols are display only.

SwapIntent.description: Exact input only; route, fee and registry policy are server-derived.

CashoutIntent.description: Beneficiary is an authorized opaque server-side reference; no arbitrary payout URL or account details.

MigrationIntent.description: First-party attested owner only, fresh recovery/step-up required; provider grants cannot initiate migration.

PrepareRequest.description: The principal supplies subject/environment/client authority. Provider requests require current grant_id. No private keys or client-provided KYC/fees.

Capability.description: Effective intersection of certified provider, account/chain/token, current session/grant and enabled driver. Empty support means unavailable.

LinkRequest.description: Requires existing Moovha-authenticated owner consent for this client/account. SIWE alone does not create a grant.

LinkChallenge.description: Complete server-created SIWE message bound to client, subject, account, chain, URI, domain, purpose, one-use nonce and expiry. Never a spending request.

Review.description: Registry-derived exact review; conditional bridge/cashout terms required by corresponding intent. Must be equivalent to the contract payload, not trusted display text.

Sponsorship.description: Grant covers full admitted cost independent of personal ETH. Native principal/business fees excluded. Actual fees and one make-good reconcile per step.

Operation.description: Drafts contain no signable actions. Commit freezes intent/review/plan. Completion requires all intended effects and finality; accepted/approved/submitted are not completed.

TypedValue.description: Initial EOA profile permits at most three container levels within each domain/message field; deeper payloads require a versioned schema/profile extension. Integer values are strings, not JSON numbers.

TypedData.description: Complete EIP-712 data. Integer fields are decimal strings; selected profile validates types and computes the EIP-712 digest. Arbitrary typed data is never accepted as a prepare intent.

Transaction.description: Fully populated initial EIP-1559 transaction. Exact chain/from/to/value/calldata and detached fees/nonce are immutable. Wallet edits require driver reconciliation, never blind retry.

Action.description: Initial EOA wire profile. submit_calls/account_operation are advertised only after a separately versioned certified driver defines its exact schema; unavailable in this revision. Unknown required action kinds must be rejected.

ActionResultRequest.description: All echoed values must equal persisted action; semantic validator checks result kind against action. Pending and HTTP acceptance confer no financial authority.

Problem.description: RFC 9457 error. No raw bodies, signatures, credentials, private keys or beneficiary PII.
